seo.title: Meeting minutes
seo.seo_description: Meeting minutes: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what to adapt for Quebec before use.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Compte rendu de réunion », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Meeting minutes.
translation.subheadline: The Meeting minutes template transcribes the audio recording while separating the speakers, writes the minutes (participants, points discussed, decisions, action table, open questions), submits them to a person and emails them to the recipient you name only after that person approves.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Meeting minutes template transcribes the audio recording while separating the speakers, writes the minutes (participants, points discussed, decisions, action table, open questions), submits them to a person and emails them to the recipient you name only after that person approves.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The recording. Audio recording of the meeting (file).
  • The participants. Participants, with their role (optional).
  • The recipient. Email address to send the minutes to.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Transcribe.
cards.text: The recording is transcribed while separating the voices: "Intervenant 1", "Intervenant 2"… These labels mean voices, not names.

cards.title: Write the minutes.
cards.text: An agent matches names mentioned to the speakers when the text allows, then writes participants, points discussed, decisions, action table and open questions.

cards.title: Approve, then send.
cards.text: A person reads the minutes and approves or refuses them. Only approval sends the email.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: Matching names to voices is not infallible: read before approving. Reading speech needs a transcription model, hence hardware if you are on premises. Set up the mail server.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a French small business. Taxes, currency, vocabulary and formats are adapted to your business and to Quebec before any use.

cards.title: A person approves before sending.
cards.text: The flow stops for a person's approval and sends the email only if they approve. The mail server (host, port, account, sender) is left to fill in.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Can it send an email without my approval?
items.answer: No. The flow stops for a person's approval and sends the email only if they approve. The mail server must be filled in.

items.question: Does the template identify who is speaking by name?
items.answer: No, it tells numbered voices apart. It matches names mentioned in the discussion to the speakers when the text allows, helped by the participant list you provide.

items.question: Does it suit Quebec as is?
items.answer: Not as is. The starter templates are written for a French small business and do not follow Quebec tax rules: taxes, formats and vocabulary are adapted to your business.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
